description: 游戏UI、游戏场景、游戏宣传图
pitfalls: 游戏截图必须加引擎关键词（Unreal Engine 5 / Unity），否则画面太'干净'
HUD元素要具体列出（血条位置/小地图位置/弹药数/技能图标），模糊描述会出乱码
游戏类型决定画面风格：FPS要第一人称/TPS要过肩视角
场景截图不要角色——纯场景展示时明确写'no characters'

scene.environment: Bustling medieval market square, stone buildings, lanterns
scene.characters: NPCs walking, a merchant at a stall, player character in center

ui_overlay.hud: Minimal HUD: top-left health/stamina bars, bottom center ability icons
ui_overlay.minimap: Top-right circular minimap showing nearby NPCs as dots
ui_overlay.health_bar: Green/red gradient bar, character portrait next to it

filled.render: Unreal Engine 5, ray tracing, photorealistic, volumetric fog
